architecture.note: Three tier sections, two focal nodes, both notes tied to their element, every cross-tier edge at right angles.

flowchart.note: Four labeled decisions, one merge into the token store, dashed data boxes for outcomes, notes sit beside the element they explain.

sequence.note: ALT fragment with two guarded regions, dashed returns, one focal success message, note tied to the orders DB.

state.note: Start and end dots, every transition labeled, focal Past due. The resume elbow runs over the edge of Active and the 'user cancels' label.

er.note: Two-part entity boxes, cardinality at both ends, N:M through a join table. The 'writes' line crosses the body of Post.

db-schema.note: Column rows with types and chips, index rows, the destructive FK is the focal arrow. The note leader crosses the INDEXES text.

timeline.note: Honest spacing, broken axis for the two-day gap, labels alternate above and below. One leader dot lands on the '//' break text.

swimlane.note: Three lanes, nine elbowed handoffs, two decision gates. Three arrow labels sit on nodes ('job live', 'no', 'offer sent') and three on lane borders.

quadrant.note: One-word axis labels beyond the tips, corner names, focal 'do first' item. Legend lists Flow / call because the axes are arrows.

tree.note: Elbow connectors without arrowheads and file sublabels, but shared/ and docs/ sit far below with long connectors that cross the src column.

org-chart.note: Front door and escalation focal, a reach path under every node, dashed page path to on-call, note tied to it.

layers.note: Six full-width bands with index tags, direction arrow, focal DB. The note was moved outside the frame after drawing and is clipped.

kanban.note: Four columns with WIP chips, the breach chip and the blocked card are the two focal elements. One wrapped card title overlaps its sublabel.

journey.note: Five stages, sentiment curve with the trough focal, three content rows, one pain marker. No legend: the map uses no notation kind.

deployment.note: Three zones, artifact chip with version, x2 replica badge, a port on every path, focal primary plus replication. The 'sync replicate' label sits on its own arrow.

dependency.note: Three ranks with fan-in badges and one focal CYCLE back-edge, but the cycle runs through db-client, edges are diagonal, and the note is clipped by the frame.
